meta.name: Sunny
meta.description: The life of an American woman living in Kyoto, Japan, is upended when her husband and son disappear in a mysterious plane crash. As consolation, she's given Sunny, one of a new class of domestic robots made by her husband's electronics company.

videos.title: He's in Refrigerators
videos.overview: In near-future Kyoto, Suzie grapples with extreme grief and receives a domestic robot to help her through.

videos.title: Don't Blame the Machine
videos.overview: As she tries to figure Sunny out, Suzie unearths memories of her husband Masa.

videos.title: Mmmm, Hinoki
videos.overview: Suzie, Sunny, and Mixxy make a discovery. Noriko pressures Suzie to have a proper funeral for Masa.

videos.title: Sticky
videos.overview: The Yakuza make themselves known. Suzie searches for the truth about Masa's lineage.

videos.title: Joey Sakamoto
videos.overview: Sunny and Suzie flee Kyoto with Mixxy to take refuge at her family's farm.

videos.title: Kyoto Manjū, So Delicious
videos.overview: Suzie officially meets Himé and her friends. Noriko learns to master the game of shogi.

videos.title: There's Been a Shift
videos.overview: Mixxy is sucker-punched by the realities of her friendship with Suzie. Himé confronts Jin.

videos.title: Trash or Not-Trash
videos.overview: In the past, Masa slowly emerges from hikikomori.

videos.title: The Dark Manual
videos.overview: After learning the truth, Suzie fights for what matters most.

meta.slogan: Its first memory is meeting you.
